name: Resist Export
description: A file panel that masks files and groups out of a download bundle, previews what will be packed, prepares it with counted progress and reports whether a repeat download matches the current masks.
project: Download panel for a 23-file design project, spring-catalogue, 41.2 MB, running as a local demo.
sizeRationale: Six rows each answer one question: which files are in, which groups are out, what will arrive, whether the frame holds at 320px, the download itself, and whether the download still matches. A preset picker was cut because it duplicated group rules.

opportunities.need: Download a chosen subset of project files and know afterwards exactly what the bundle holds.
opportunities.use: A designer sends a client handoff without drafts or licensed fonts, then repeats the download after one change.
opportunities.interaction: Layered reversible masks on files and groups, a fixed-label reveal of masked files, a counted prepare state and a mask-aware repeat.
opportunities.similarity: 10-28 load stages and 10-29 import stage track counted pending work. 10-30 link options flagged drift. This set adds selective exclusion before the job and restores masks after it. Tradeoff: more input surface than a single download button.

selection.rationale: It is the only candidate and the explicit edition brief. Resist dyeing maps onto masking files from a download, which serves the download-button task directly.

components.name: Mask file tree
components.description: File tree with an Include checkbox per file, tri-state folders and a mask-source mark per row.
components.purpose: Choose which single files go into the download and see why each excluded file is out.
components.use: A designer unchecks layouts/cover-v1.indd and sees it marked 'masked by hand'.
components.input: Click or tap a checkbox or a folder disclosure. Keyboard: Tab into the tree, Up and Down move, Right and Left expand and collapse, Space toggles Include, Home and End jump.
components.outcome: The file's include state changes, its folder updates to checked, mixed or unchecked, and the bundle count in row 3 updates.
components.recovery: Checking a file again lifts its hand mask. Checking a file masked by a rule adds an exception, labelled 'kept despite Drafts'.
components.mechanism: APG treeview with roving tabindex. Included is computed as not hand-masked and not (rule-masked without an exception). Rule masks show a 1px dashed edge, and hand masks show a 3px solid bar. Each mark is paired with its word.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-10-29 file manifest listed per-file outcomes after an import. This tree sets inclusion before the job and names the mask layer.
components.usefulness: A bundle builder that hides why a file is missing causes resend requests.
components.creativeDifference: Each excluded row names its resist layer, so hand and group masks never blur together.
states: default: all 23 included, reached on load
hand-masked: solid bar and 'masked by hand', reached by unchecking
rule-masked: dashed edge and rule name, reached by row 2
exception: 'kept despite <rule>', reached by checking a rule-masked file
mixed folder: aria-checked=mixed
focus: 2px ring on the row

sources.title: V&A: Cloth of a continent, Africa Fashion

components.name: Group resist rules
components.description: Three toggle buttons that mask a whole group of files as one layer, each showing how many files it covers.
components.purpose: Exclude a group by type in one action, and lift it without touching hand masks.
components.use: A designer turns on 'Drafts · 4' and 'Fonts · 2' for a client handoff.
components.input: Click or tap a rule. Keyboard: Tab to each button, Enter or Space toggles.
components.outcome: The covered files become rule-masked, and the label reads 'Masking 6 files'.
components.recovery: Turning a rule off lifts only that layer. Hand masks and exceptions stay as they were.
components.mechanism: Native buttons with aria-pressed. Each rule is a predicate over file tags, stored as its own layer. Counts come from the predicate, so overlap between rules is counted once in the total.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-10-26 log viewer severity filter narrowed a view. These rules change the output and stack as separate layers.
components.usefulness: Unchecking four drafts across three folders by hand is slow, and it is easy to miss one.
components.creativeDifference: Group edits are reversible layers, so lifting one never undoes another.
states: off: no fill, reached on load
on: aria-pressed=true with an accent edge
overlap: total reads 'Masking 6 files · 1 in two rules'
empty rule: disabled with 'none in project'
focus: 2px ring

sources.title: V&A: Cloth of a continent, Africa Fashion

components.name: Bundle reveal preview
components.description: Read-only view of the bundle as packed, with a Show resisted toggle that reveals masked files in place under a fixed count label.
components.purpose: Show exactly what will arrive, and on request what was left out.
components.use: A designer reads '17 files · 33.8 MB · 6 resisted', reveals them and spots a font they meant to keep.
components.input: Click or tap Show resisted. Keyboard: Tab to it, Enter or Space toggles.
components.outcome: Resisted rows appear at their tree positions, dimmed and struck, each with its mask word.
components.recovery: Toggling off hides them again. The preview never edits masks.
components.mechanism: Rendered from the computed include set. The count label sits in a fixed-height header with tabular numerals in a reserved width. Revealed rows fade in over 180ms and appear instantly under reduced motion.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-11-01 card fit preview rendered a draft in its finished form. This renders the finished bundle and its gaps.
components.usefulness: The visitor sees the result before packing.
components.creativeDifference: Detail appears and recedes while the main label holds still.
states: packed view: included files only, reached on load
revealed: resisted rows shown, aria-pressed=true
nothing resisted: toggle disabled with 'Nothing resisted'
empty bundle: 'No files to download'
focus: 2px ring

sources.title: V&A: Cloth of a continent, Africa Fashion

components.name: Export panel frame
components.description: Two-pane file panel with a pinned action foot that collapses to one column with a preview disclosure under 480px.
components.purpose: Keep the tree, the preview and the download button usable at every width.
components.use: A designer on a 320px phone keeps the Download button in reach while scrolling 23 files.
components.input: Click or tap Preview bundle at narrow widths. Keyboard: Tab to it, Enter or Space toggles.
components.outcome: The panel shows two panes at 480px and above. Below that it shows one column with the preview behind a disclosure.
components.recovery: Widening the container restores two panes and keeps the disclosure state for the next narrow view.
components.mechanism: CSS container query on the panel. The body scrolls between a sticky header and a sticky foot. The foot holds row 5 at a minimum height of 44px and full width when narrow. Long file names wrap and are never truncated.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-11-01 details side panel managed focus in a dialog. This frame manages space and keeps the action reachable without a dialog.
components.usefulness: A download button that scrolls away on a phone stops the task.
components.creativeDifference: The narrow layout trades the preview pane for a disclosure, and the button stays fixed in the foot.
states: wide: two panes, reached at container width 480px and above
narrow: one column with a Preview bundle disclosure
preview-open: disclosure expanded, aria-expanded=true
320px: 16px padding and a full-width foot button
focus: 2px ring on the disclosure

components.name: Download bundle button
components.description: Native button that prepares, completes and repeats a download, counting real packed files and reusing a cached bundle when the masks match.
components.purpose: Prepare and save the bundle, and make the repeat action say whether it is the same bundle.
components.use: A designer downloads, unmasks one font, and the button reads 'Prepare new bundle · 1 change'.
components.input: Click or tap the button, minimum 44px tall. Keyboard: Tab to it, Enter or Space. Escape stops a preparation in progress.
components.outcome: The label moves from 'Download 17 files · 33.8 MB' to 'Preparing · 7 of 17' to 'Downloaded'. It then holds at 'Download again · same bundle'.
components.recovery: Presses while preparing are ignored. Escape stops the preparation and returns the label to idle with 'Stopped at 7 of 17'. A demo failure reads 'Not prepared · Retry'.
components.mechanism: A packing loop over the included files, 60ms per file, increments the shown count. No percentage is shown. The result is a local JSON manifest Blob saved through an object URL and an anchor with a download attribute. The bundle id is a short hash of the sorted included ids. A repeat with a matching id reuses the cached Blob. Label width is reserved for the longest label.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-10-30 copy link button reported version-aware repeats. This adds counted preparation and a cached file for the repeat.
components.usefulness: This button is the core task.
components.creativeDifference: The repeat label states whether the masks changed before the press.
states: idle: count and size, reached on load
pressed: 1px sink on pointer or key down
preparing: disabled with 'Preparing · n of N'
complete: 'Downloaded' for 1.2s, then settled
repeat-same: 'Download again · same bundle'
repeat-changed: 'Prepare new bundle · n changes'
stopped: via Escape
failed: 'Not prepared · Retry'
empty: disabled, reached when the bundle is empty
focus: 2px ring
reduced-motion: label swaps without transition

components.name: Bundle drift receipt
components.description: Status receipt naming the downloaded bundle, which flags drift when masks change and can restore the downloaded mask set.
components.purpose: Record what was downloaded and say when the screen no longer matches it.
components.use: A designer reads 'Bundle a3f9 out of date · 1 file added since' and presses Restore masks.
components.input: Click or tap Show changes or Restore masks. Keyboard: Tab to each, Enter or Space.
components.outcome: The receipt reads 'spring-catalogue · 17 files · 33.8 MB · 14:06 · bundle a3f9'. On drift it lists the added and removed files.
components.recovery: Restore masks sets hand masks, rules and exceptions back to the a3f9 snapshot. An Undo restore option is offered for 5s.
components.mechanism: role=status, with polite announcements on completion and on the first drift only. The mask snapshot is stored with the bundle id. Drift is a set difference between the snapshot include set and the current include set.
components.nearestAnalogue: 2026-10-30 link options field flagged clipboard drift. This receipt also restores the earlier masks.
components.usefulness: It shows which files the downloaded copy holds after the button has reset.
components.creativeDifference: The mask can be reapplied exactly from the record.
states: hidden: before the first download
current: receipt line
drifted: 'out of date' with change counts
changes-shown: list of added and removed files
restored: 'Masks restored to a3f9' with Undo
focus: 2px ring

demo.sharedState: One store holds the 23 spring-catalogue files with tags and sizes, handMasks, active rules, exceptions and the last bundle {id, snapshot, blob, time}. Rows 1 and 2 write masks. Row 3 reads the computed include set. Row 4 frames all rows. Row 5 packs the include set and writes the bundle. Row 6 compares the bundle snapshot with the current set and can write the snapshot back.

culture.name: Yoruba adire resist-dye craft
culture.idea: Interpret resist dyeing as reversible masks, selective reveal and grouped editing; do not copy named symbolic motifs.
